# SAIS Events

> SAIS Events (registered as SAIS EXPO COORDINATORS) is a MICE company based in Nairobi, Kenya, with an office in Dubai, UAE. It connects international exhibition organisers, manufacturers, exporters, qualified buyers, exhibitors and business delegates across Africa and the Middle East. Services: hosted buyer programme coordination, international delegate sourcing, qualified buyer recruitment, exhibitor recruitment, B2B matchmaking, trade missions, business delegations and factory visits. Hosted buyer benefits and approval are decided by each event organiser. Tagline: Connecting Global Business. Creating Opportunities.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://saisevents.com/): MICE services, hosted buyer programmes, upcoming international exhibitions, coverage and team
- [For exhibition organisers](https://saisevents.com/partner.html): how SAIS sources, qualifies and coordinates buyers and exhibitors for organisers
- [SAIS MatchMarket](https://saisevents.com/matchmarket.html): verified B2B profiles, company discovery and AI-assisted matchmaking
- [MatchMarket directory](https://saisevents.com/directory.html): public list of vetted companies
- [Questions and answers](https://saisevents.com/faq.html): MICE, hosted buyer programmes, vetting, documents, costs, visas
- [AFROPLAST 2027 registration](https://saisevents.com/afroplast-2027.html): official East Africa hosted buyer registration, Cairo, 9 to 12 January 2027
- [AGROEXPO 2027 registration](https://saisevents.com/agroexpo-2027.html): official Africa hosted buyer registration, İzmir, Türkiye, 2 to 6 February 2027
- [ALUMINIUM CHINA 2027 registration](https://saisevents.com/aluminium-china-2027.html): Africa hosted buyer registration, Shanghai, 7 to 9 July 2027
- [Food Africa Cairo 2026](https://saisevents.com/food-africa-2026.html): hosted buyer programme, 7 to 10 December 2026
- [Kenya Homes Expo 2026](https://saisevents.com/kenya-homes-expo-2026.html): exhibitor registration, KICC Nairobi, 19 to 22 November 2026 (SAIS Events is Official Marketing Partner)
- [VIP Members Programme](https://saisevents.com/vip-members.html): one-time USD 300 membership
- [Delegates whitelist](https://saisevents.com/membership.html)
